import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesInclusion
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyKernelDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModulesKernelSections

/-!
# The Cartier kernel of a field-fibre divisor family

The effective Weil divisor extracted from a field-valued divisor family gives
the canonical invertible ideal inclusion `O(-D) -> O_X`. The Cartier chart
equations identify its sections with the actual quotient kernel. This gives
a global isomorphism with `kernel x.q`, compatible with the inclusion into
the structure sheaf, as in Kleiman Section 3, `sb:ediv`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance : IsIntegral (pullback π s) := fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)
noncomputable local instance : (pullback π s).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  .ofHom (pullback.snd π s)
local instance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)
local instance : LocallyOfFiniteType
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd π s))
local instance : QuasiCompact ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (pullback.snd π s))

/-- The effective Weil divisor of a field-test family determines its ideal
inclusion into the structure-sheaf module. -/
noncomputable def effectiveWeilDivisorIdeal
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) ⟶
      divisorModules K (0 : (pullback π s).CurveDivisor) :=
  divisorModulesLE K (by
    intro z
    change -x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z ≤ 0
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr (by simp))

/-- The Weil ideal inclusion with its target identified with the structure sheaf. -/
noncomputable def effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π s).ringCatSheaf :=
  x.effectiveWeilDivisorIdeal ≫ (divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom

instance effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion_mono (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    Mono x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion := by
  dsimp only [effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion, effectiveWeilDivisorIdeal]
  infer_instance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The ideal inclusion sends a bounded rational function to the regular
function with the same generic germ. -/
theorem germ_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (W : (pullback π s).Opens)
    (hW : (W : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty)
    (a : Γ(divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor), W)) :
    ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ W (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom
        (x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion.app W a) = divisorVal K a := by
  rw [effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion, Modules.Hom.comp_app, AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply,
    germ_divisorModulesZeroIso_hom K hW]
  exact divisorVal_divisorModulesLE K _ a

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Membership in the Weil ideal is exactly membership of the regular
function's generic germ in the negative-divisor section module. -/
theorem exists_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion_eq_iff
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (W : (pullback π s).Opens)
    (hW : (W : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty) (r : Γ(pullback π s, W)) :
    (∃ a, x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion.app W a = r) ↔
      ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ W (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom r ∈
        divisorSections K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) W := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [germ_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion x W hW]
    exact a.property
  · intro hr
    refine ⟨⟨_, hr⟩, ?_⟩
    apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral (pullback π s) (U := W)
      (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)
    rw [germ_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion x W hW]
    rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On any nonempty open of the field fibre, the actual quotient kills a
regular function precisely when its generic germ satisfies the Weil ideal bounds. -/
theorem normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem_on_open
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (W : (pullback π s).Opens)
    (hW : (W : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty) (r : Γ(pullback π s, W)) :
    (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W) r = 0 ↔
      ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ W (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom r ∈
        divisorSections K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) W := by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K hW]
    intro z hz hzW
    obtain ⟨U, hzU, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_chart_kernel_iso x z
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨z, hzU⟩⟩
    let V : (U : Scheme).Opens := U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let W' : (pullback π s).Opens := U.ι ''ᵁ V
    have hzW' : z ∈ W' := ⟨⟨z, hzU⟩, hzW, rfl⟩
    have hW' : (W' : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty := ⟨z, hzW'⟩
    have hle : W' ≤ W := U.ι.image_preimage_le W
    let r' := (pullback π s).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op r
    have hr' : (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W') r' = 0 := by
      change (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W')
        ((SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π s).ringCatSheaf).val.map
          (homOfLE hle).op r) = 0
      exact (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (normalizedQuotient x).val
        (homOfLE hle).op r).trans (by rw [hr, map_zero])
    have hb := (normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem x U e V hW' r').mp hr'
    have hv := (mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K hW').mp hb z hz hzW'
    dsimp only [r'] at hv
    rwa [(pullback π s).presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hv
  · intro hr
    apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext
      (⟨x.F.presheaf, x.F.isSheaf⟩ :
        TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (pullback π s : Scheme).toTopCat) W
    intro z hzW
    obtain ⟨U, hzU, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_chart_kernel_iso x z
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨z, hzU⟩⟩
    let V : (U : Scheme).Opens := U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let W' : (pullback π s).Opens := U.ι ''ᵁ V
    have hzW' : z ∈ W' := ⟨⟨z, hzU⟩, hzW, rfl⟩
    have hW' : (W' : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty := ⟨z, hzW'⟩
    have hle : W' ≤ W := U.ι.image_preimage_le W
    let r' := (pullback π s).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op r
    have hb : ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ W'
        (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
          (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW')).hom r' ∈
        divisorSections K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) W' := by
      dsimp only [r']
      rw [(pullback π s).presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      exact divisorSections_antitone K hle hW' hr
    have hr' : (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W') r' = 0 :=
      (normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem x U e V hW' r').mpr hb
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (normalizedQuotient x).val
      (homOfLE hle).op r
    have heq : x.F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        ((normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W) r) = 0 := hn.symm.trans hr'
    rw [← x.F.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hle) z hzW', heq, map_zero, map_zero]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The Weil ideal inclusion is annihilated by the actual normalized quotient. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion_comp_normalizedQuotient
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion ≫ normalizedQuotient x = 0 := by
  apply Modules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext a
  change (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op W)
    (x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion.app W a) = 0
  by_cases hW : (W : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty
  · apply (normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem_on_open x W hW _).mpr
    rw [germ_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion x W hW]
    exact a.property
  · exact x.F.isSheaf.section_ext (fun z hz => (hW ⟨z, hz⟩).elim)

/-- The canonical map from the Weil ideal to the actual normalized kernel. -/
noncomputable def effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) ⟶ kernel (normalizedQuotient x) :=
  kernel.lift (normalizedQuotient x) x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion
    x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion_comp_normalizedQuotient

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
instance effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel_isIso
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) : IsIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel := by
  apply Modules.isIso_kernel_lift_of_sectionwise_exact
  intro W r hr
  by_cases hW : (W : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty
  · exact (exists_effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion_eq_iff x W hW r).mpr
      ((normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem_on_open x W hW r).mp hr)
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (Modules.isSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π s).ringCatSheaf)).section_ext
      (fun z hz => (hW ⟨z, hz⟩).elim)

/-- The Weil ideal is canonically isomorphic to the original Cartier kernel
of the field-test divisor family. -/
noncomputable def effectiveWeilDivisorKernelIso
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) ≅ kernel x.q :=
  asIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel ≪≫
    kernelIsIsoComp (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)).inv x.q

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The global comparison preserves the inclusion into the structure sheaf. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisorKernelIso_hom_ι
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    x.effectiveWeilDivisorKernelIso.hom ≫ kernel.ι x.q ≫
        (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π s)).hom =
      x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion := by
  simp only [effectiveWeilDivisorKernelIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    kernelIsIsoComp_hom, Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι_assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
